propositions: The packaged code-review guide (src/rebar/_guides/passing-code-review.md) still instructs contributors to ping maintainers for coverage-gap blocks, but the self-service recheck-review command now exists as the primary resolution path.
The guide is the most discoverable contributor on-ramp for the Gerrit LLM-Review gate and its stale text actively misdirects users away from self-service remediation.
The recheck-review self-service re-trigger was merged in production (Gerrit change 1243) but the packaged guide was not updated in parallel with docs/review-policy.md and CONTRIBUTING.md.

The coverage-gap bullet (lines ~112–114) must be updated to name recheck-review as the contributor self-service trigger and clarify that coverage-gap -1 is an infrastructure veto, not a code review finding.
